tools.name: analyze_site
tools.description: Analyse any website and return three high-leverage growth plays it could start this week. Free — no subscription required.

tools.name: list_workspaces
tools.description: List the growth workspaces (businesses) belonging to the signed-in user, with their website, goal, stage and budget.

tools.name: get_business
tools.description: Read one workspace's full profile — website, description, audience, industry, stage, goal, budget, hours per week, competitors, channels, what has been tried — plus the notes stored with add_business_note and a quick progress summary. Use it before giving advice so it fits this business.

tools.name: get_plan
tools.description: Read the ranked growth plays for one workspace. Returns title, category, fit score, effort, budget, tools and status, ordered by rank.

tools.name: get_play
tools.description: Read the full detail of one growth play: rationale, steps, tools, budget and success metric.

tools.name: update_play_status
tools.description: Change a growth play's state: start it (in_progress), park it for later (snoozed, with days), skip it for good (skipped, with a reason), reopen it (open) or finish it (done). Mirrors the To do / In progress / Done / Parked board in the app.

tools.name: submit_play_draft
tools.description: Save the finished work for one play (copy, code or research, in markdown) onto the founder's gtm.help board as Ready to review. Use this whenever you have written the work for a play, instead of leaving it only in chat. It never marks the play done and never publishes anything.

tools.name: complete_play
tools.description: Mark a growth play as shipped (or reopen it). Completing a play unlocks the next one in the ranked plan.

tools.name: add_business_note
tools.description: Save a note about the business so the growth plan and the consultant remember it (results, context, constraints).

tools.name: share_recap
tools.description: Create a public, shareable summary of recent progress for a workspace. Returns a URL that can be pasted into a chat, tweet, report or Slack thread.

tools.name: list_opportunities
tools.description: Read the Reddit, LinkedIn and X conversations the agents found for a workspace: threads, posts and comments where the user's business can genuinely help. Ranked by fit and heat. Use draft_reply to write an answer and update_opportunity to record what happened. Nothing is ever posted automatically.

tools.name: draft_reply
tools.description: Write a reply for one Reddit, LinkedIn or X opportunity from list_opportunities, using the business's own context and the workspace's writing settings (karma-safe, mention business). Returns the text and the exact link to paste it at. gtm.help never posts on the user's behalf — the user copies, edit

tools.name: update_opportunity
tools.description: Record what happened to a Reddit, LinkedIn or X opportunity: replied (the user posted their answer — include the link), ignored (not a fit, with an optional reason that sharpens future ranking), snoozed (come back later) or open (put it back on the board).

tools.name: update_watchlist
tools.description: Read or change the watch lists behind the Reddit, LinkedIn or X agent for a workspace: keywords, topics the business can answer, competitors, people/accounts, and (Reddit only) subreddits. Each list holds up to 10 entries. Call with no add/remove to just read them.

tools.name: list_integrations
tools.description: Show which tools a workspace has connected (Google Analytics, Search Console, Composio apps such as HubSpot, Stripe, Shopify, Mailchimp and more) with their health, and the most recent metric summary synced from each. Read-only.

tools.name: list_invoices
tools.description: Read the user's gtm.help billing history: invoice number, date, status, amount, tax and links to the PDF and hosted receipt. Only the signed-in customer's own invoices are visible.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_opportunities · Private data: list_opportunities, update_opportunity · Public sink: submit_play_draft, share_recap · Destructive: update_watchlist.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_opportunities · Private data: list_opportunities, update_opportunity · Public sink: submit_play_draft, share_recap · Destructive: update_watchlist

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
